passage:
A school placed battery recycling boxes near the office. The science teacher explained that batteries should not be thrown into normal trash because they can contain materials harmful to the environment.
At first, students forgot. Then the eco-club made a display showing how many batteries had been collected each week.
The number grew quickly.
Students brought batteries from remote controls, toys, and clocks at home. Some parents thanked the school because they had not known where to take them.
The box was small, but it connected home habits with environmental care.
Recycling works better when people know exactly where to put things and why it matters.
